messages:
Rina (Docs): Quick sync — I'm drafting the index/migration page for the v1 -> v2 sunset and there's a small UX/error messaging callout we should add. The old /embeddings endpoint can surface a 400 about vector_dim mismatch; we should show the exact fix users can paste into their apps and a short SDK snippet.

Kevin (SDK): I have an open PR that touches param names and aliasing: github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/5421. It introduces `model_id` and keeps `model` as an alias for a transition period. I can add a tiny example and an inline note about the alias behavior.

Rina (Docs): Nice. For the index page I'd like one short example (TS + curl) and a micro note: "If you see X error, do Y". Can you drop the TS snippet here so I can copy/paste? Also add the expected response change for embedding dims.

Kevin (SDK): Sure — here's a compact TS snippet for the new param name and a safe fallback map for renamed models:```ts
// SDK: prefer model_id, fallback to old model alias
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RDW_KEY });

const modelMap: Record<string, string> = {
  'text-embed-legacy': 'text-embed-2',
};

const requested = 'text-embed-legacy';
const model_id = modelMap[requested] ?? requested; // maps old -> new

const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model_id, input: ['hello'] });
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length); // assert dim
```

Maya (Eng): Two quick technical caveats to call out for the doc: 1) runtime will return a 400 that includes the phrase "vector_dim" when dims mismatch, so the "if resp.error includes 'vector_dim'" check is reliable; 2) when we swap model families the KV cache behavior might change — add a short note recommending pinned model versions for deterministic behavior during rollout.

Rina (Docs): Good points. I'll add a one-line paragraph: "If you see a 400 mentioning vector_dim, verify your model_id and remap/quantize embeddings. If you rely on exact vectors across rollouts, pin model version." Keep it short.

Sam (PM): For comms: let's coordinate a tiny changelog line and a single-sentence migration note in the API breakage section. This should be included in the Sunset email next week and the in-console banner. Kevin — can you add a short blurb in your SDK PR that we can copy into changelog?

Kevin (SDK): Yep, I'll add a 1-2 sentence blurb in PR 5421 and add a README section with the fallback map example above.

docs-bot: Redirect created -> /docs/reference/embeddings/v1 -> /docs/reference/embeddings/v2 (auto-redirect) :white_check_mark:

Rina (Docs): Action items: 1) Kevin — add blurb + tiny README snippet (PR 5421). 2) Kevin/Maya — add test case that simulates dim mismatch and confirms the 400 message. 3) Sam — add changelog line + comms note. 4) Rina — will paste the TS and curl examples into the index page and add the "vector_dim" troubleshooting line.

Kevin (SDK): Assigned and will ping reviewers. I'll try to land the PR today or tomorrow.

Maya (Eng): I'll drop a minimal integration test in the runtime repo and link it here when done.

Rina (Docs): Perfect. Ping me once PR is green and I'll merge the doc patch. :thumbsup: 

Sam (PM): Thanks all — be mindful of localization work (we only need the short troubleshooting sentence localized). Rina — can you add the short text to the translation queue if we merge before EOD?

Rina (Docs): Will do. I'll also add a note in the PR description about localization so translations get picked up.

(End)
